style_ko.il: 외운 문장 몇 개를 나열. 현재형 위주, 짧은 단문.
style_ko.im1: 단문을 이어 문단 비슷하게. 현재·과거를 구분해서 써요.
style_ko.im2: 도입 → 내용 → 마무리 흐름. 이유와 간단한 예시.
style_ko.im3: 문단 단위로 말하기. 시제 바꿔 가며 경험 이야기, 감정 표현.
style_ko.ih: 경험을 시간 순서로 구체적으로. 비교, 바뀐 점, 돌발 상황 대처.
style_ko.al: 긴 문단을 막힘없이. 다양한 시제·가정, 의견과 근거를 길게.

self_assessment.ko: 단어 몇 개나 외운 문장 정도로만 말할 수 있어요.
아는 주제라면 짧은 문장으로 기본적인 내용을 말할 수 있어요.
익숙한 주제는 문장을 이어서 말할 수 있지만 자주 막혀요.
낯선 주제도 의견과 근거를 들어 길게 말할 수 있어요.

self_intro: 이름보다 하는 일·사는 곳·좋아하는 것을 중심으로 말했어요
문장 네다섯 개 이상으로 1분 가까이 말했어요
외운 티가 나지 않게 중간에 내 생각을 한 마디 넣었어요
description: 전체 모습을 한 문장으로 먼저 말했어요
장소·사물을 두세 가지로 나눠 구체적으로 묘사했어요
routine: 순서(first, then, after that)를 넣어 하루나 과정을 설명했어요
그 일을 하면 어떤 기분인지 덧붙였어요
past_experience: 언제, 어디서 있었던 일인지 먼저 말했어요
그 일로 느낀 점이나 바뀐 점으로 마무리했어요
comparison: 예전과 지금(또는 두 대상)을 분명히 나눠 말했어요
바뀐 점을 두 가지 이상 말했어요
issue: 사람들이 걱정하는 문제가 무엇인지 먼저 설명했어요
해결 방법이나 바람을 한 마디 했어요
roleplay_ask: 상황에 맞게 인사하고 왜 연락했는지 말했어요
Can I…? / Do you…? / How much…? 처럼 질문 형태를 바꿔 썼어요
roleplay_solve: 무슨 문제가 생겼는지 상대에게 먼저 설명했어요
정중한 표현(I'm sorry, Would it be possible…)을 썼어요
roleplay_experience: 비슷한 문제를 겪은 때와 장소를 말했어요
무슨 일이 있었는지 과거형으로 순서대로 말했어요

gym.situation_ko: 집 근처 헬스장에 전화해서 등록 정보를 묻고, 등록하자마자 헬스장이 공사로 문을 닫는 문제를 해결해요.

questions.question: I'd like to give you a situation and ask you to act it out. You want to join a new gym near your home. Call the gym and ask three or four questions to get the information you need.

il.text: Hi. I want to join your gym. How much is it for one month? What time do you open? Do you have showers? Thank you.
phrases: I want to join your gym

il.text: Hello. I live near your gym. Can I exercise in the morning? Do you have yoga classes? How much is it? Thanks.

im1.text: Hi, I'm calling because I want to join a gym near my house. I have some questions. How much is the membership for three months? What time do you open in the morning? I usually work out before work. Also, do you have personal trainers? Thank you.

Hello, I just moved to this area, and I'm looking for a gym. Can I ask a few questions? Do you have group classes like yoga or spinning? Are you open on weekends? And is there a parking lot? Thank you for your help.
phrases: I just moved to this area
Can I ask a few questions

im2.text: Hi, I'm calling because I'm interested in joining your gym. I want to get in shape before summer, so I have a few questions. First, how much does it cost for one month and for six months? Second, what are your opening hours on weekdays? Also, do you have a personal training program for beginners? And finally, can I use the gym once for free before I sign up? Thank you.
phrases: I want to get in shape

im2.text: Hello, I'm looking for a gym for my wife and me. We both work late, so I want to ask some questions. Are you open until midnight? Do you have a discount for couples? Also, are there lockers and towels for members? And how crowded is the gym in the evening? Thanks so much for your help.
phrases: Do you have a discount for couples

im3.text: Hi there, I'm thinking about joining a gym for the first time, and a friend recommended yours, so I'd like to ask a few questions. First of all, how much are your memberships? I'd probably go three or four times a week. Also, I've never used gym machines before, so is there someone who can show me how to use them? Do you have group classes for beginners? And lastly, when is the gym the least busy? Thanks.
phrases: when is the gym the least busy

im3.text: Hello, I'm calling because I recently hurt my back, and my doctor told me to start exercising regularly. So I'm looking for a gym that's good for beginners. Do you have trainers who work with people with back problems? How much are personal training sessions? Also, is there a swimming pool? I heard swimming is good for your back. And finally, are there any special prices for new members this month? Thank you.
phrases: I heard swimming is good for

ih.text: Hi, how's it going? I'm calling because I just moved into the apartment complex across the street, and I'm looking for a gym that's close to home. I've been working out for a few years, so I have some specific questions. First, I mostly do weight training, so do you have enough squat racks and free weights? Second, how much is a twelve-month membership, and is there a discount if I pay all at once? I'm also curious about how crowded it gets around seven. And lastly, do you offer a trial period? Thanks a lot.
phrases: is there a discount if I pay all at once

ih.text: Hello, I hope you can help me. My daughter and I want to start exercising together, so we're looking for a gym that's good for both of us. She's sixteen, so first of all, do you allow teenagers to join? Second, do you have family memberships, and how much do they cost? We're also interested in group classes, especially dance or yoga, so could you tell me what classes are available on weekends? Finally, is there a women's locker room with showers and hair dryers? Thank you so much.
phrases: do you allow teenagers to join
could you tell me what classes

al.text: Hi, thanks for picking up. I've been meaning to get back into shape for a while now, and your gym came up when I was searching for places near my office. Before I commit, I'd love to ask you a few things. To begin with, what are your opening hours on weekdays? Some days I'd like to come in before work, around six. Next, is there a cheaper plan if I only come on weekdays? I'm also wondering about personal training. Is the first session free, and how are trainers matched with members? Lastly, can I freeze my membership if I travel for work? Thank you.

Hello, I hope I'm not catching you at a busy time. My husband and I are planning to join a gym together, and a coworker said great things about yours, so I'd like to ask a handful of questions. First of all, do you offer couple memberships, and how much would we save compared to two individual ones? Second, we're both pretty new to working out, so do you run any orientation sessions for beginners? On top of that, are there set hours for lap swimming in the pool? And finally, what's your cancellation policy if one of us moves away? Thanks so much.
phrases: I hope I'm not catching you at a busy time

questions.tip_ko: 내 상황(초보, 아침 운동, 가족과 함께)을 먼저 말하면 질문이 자연스럽게 이어져요. 질문은 가격, 시간, 시설로 나눠요.

questions.question: I'm sorry, but there's a problem. Right after you paid for a three-month membership, the gym announces that it will close for a month for repairs. Call the gym manager, explain the situation, and suggest two or three ways to solve the problem.

il.text: Hi. I paid for three months. But now the gym is closed for one month. I can't exercise. Can I get one more month free? Or my money back? Thank you.
Hello. I have a problem. Your gym is closed. I paid a lot of money. Can I use another gym? Or can you give me a refund? Please call me back.

im1.text: Hi, this is Minsu. I'm a member of your gym. I paid for a three-month membership last week, but today I saw a notice that the gym will close for one month because of repairs. I'm a little upset because I just started exercising. Can you add one more month to my membership? Or maybe I can use another gym nearby? If not, I want a refund for one month. Thank you.
phrases: Can you add one more month

im1.text: Hello, I'm calling about my gym membership. I signed up for three months, and I paid two hundred thousand won. But now the gym is closing for a month for repairs, and I didn't know about this. It's not fair. Could you give me back the money for one month? Or you can make my membership one month longer. Please let me know. Thanks.

im2.text: Hi, my name is Jiyoung, and I'm a member of your gym. I signed up for a three-month membership just two weeks ago, and I paid for everything in advance. But yesterday, I saw a sign on the door saying the gym will be closed for a whole month for repairs. Nobody told me about this when I registered, so I'm pretty disappointed. I have a few ideas to solve this. First, you could extend my membership by one month. Second, maybe I could use one of your other branches during the repairs. Or third, you could refund one month of the fee. Please call me back. Thank you.
phrases: I have a few ideas to solve this

im2.text: Hello, I'm calling because I have a problem with my membership. I just paid for three months of personal training and gym use, and now I hear that the gym is closing for four weeks because of construction. I was planning to lose weight before my sister's wedding, so this is really bad timing for me. Could my trainer meet me at a park or another place for our sessions? If that's not possible, could you add the four weeks at the end of my membership? Or I'd like to get a partial refund. I hope we can find a good solution. Thanks.
phrases: this is really bad timing for me
I hope we can find a good solution

im3.text: Hi, this is Daniel Cho. I'm calling about my membership. I signed up for a three-month plan about ten days ago, and I paid the full amount at the front desk. But when I went to the gym this morning, I found a notice saying it'll be closed for a whole month starting next week because of repairs. Honestly, I'm pretty frustrated, because nobody mentioned this when I registered. I have a regular workout routine, and taking a month off would really set me back. So I'd like to suggest a few options. First, is there any chance I could use a partner gym nearby during the repairs? If not, could you extend my membership by a month? Otherwise, I'd like a refund for the month the gym is closed. Thanks.

Hello, my name is Sora, and I'm a member at your downtown location. I paid for three months last week, mostly because I wanted to take the morning yoga classes. Today, though, I got a text message saying the whole building will be closed for a month for repairs, and that all classes are canceled. I was really surprised, because I had just paid. I understand repairs are necessary, but I think I should get something for the month I lose. Could the yoga teacher hold classes online during the repairs? Or could you add one month to my membership? If neither is possible, I'd like you to refund part of my payment. Please call me back when you get a chance. Thank you.

ih.text: Hi, this is Kevin Park calling. I'm a member at your gym, and I'm calling because of the closure notice I just received. I signed up for a three-month membership about two weeks ago, and I paid the full amount up front, which was quite a lot of money for me. But now I've been told that the gym will be closed for an entire month for renovations. I completely understand that repairs need to be done, but I really wish someone had told me before I signed up, because I probably would have waited. Anyway, I'd like to suggest a few ways we could solve this. First, if you have another branch or a partner gym in the area, I'd be happy to use that temporarily. Second, you could simply extend my membership by one month. And finally, if neither option works, I think a partial refund would be fair. Please let me know which option works best.
phrases: I really wish someone had told me
a partial refund would be fair

ih.text: Hello, I hope you're doing well. My name is Eunji, and I've been a member at your gym for a couple of years now. I just renewed my membership for three months, along with ten personal training sessions, and I paid for everything last Monday. This morning, however, the front desk staff told me that the gym is going to close for about a month because of repair work on the pipes. To be honest, I'm a bit frustrated, because my trainer and I had just started a new program, and I'm preparing for a half marathon in the fall. So I'd like to ask about a few options. Could my trainer and I continue our sessions at another location, maybe outdoors? If that's not possible, could you freeze my membership and training sessions until the gym reopens? Or, as a last option, I'd like a refund for the unused month. Thank you.

al.text: Hi, my name is Jason Lee, and I'm calling about my membership. I'm sorry to bother you, but I've just found out about the upcoming closure, and I'd like to talk about how it affects me. About two weeks ago, I signed up for a three-month membership and paid the entire amount at once, partly because the staff told me it was the best deal. Then yesterday, I got an email saying the gym will be completely closed for a month starting next week, due to repairs on the locker rooms and the air conditioning. Now, I understand that these things happen, but frankly, it's a little disappointing that no one mentioned it when I was signing up, especially since the repairs must have been planned in advance. So, I'd like to propose a few solutions. First of all, if there's a partner gym nearby, I'd be willing to work out there during the closure. Alternatively, you could extend my membership by a month at no extra cost. And if neither of those is possible, I'd like a refund for the month the gym is closed. I hope we can work something out.
phrases: I understand that these things happen
I hope we can work something out

al.text: Hello, this is Mina Kang. I've been a member at your gym for almost three years, and I've always been really happy with the service, so I'm a little surprised to be making this call. Last week, I renewed my membership for another three months, and I also signed up for the small-group strength classes that start this month. However, I just saw the notice on the front door saying that the entire facility will be closed for a month while you replace the floors. I completely understand that the floors needed work, but the timing is pretty frustrating, since I'd planned my whole training schedule around these classes. With that in mind, I'd like to suggest a few things. Ideally, the classes could move to another space, like a community center or even a park, at least on weekends. If that doesn't work, could you put my membership on hold and restart it once you reopen? And if that's not possible either, I think a partial refund would be the fairest solution. Thanks for listening, and I look forward to hearing from you.
phrases: I look forward to hearing from you

questions.tip_ko: 이름과 회원 정보를 먼저 밝히고, 언제 얼마를 냈는지 말해요. 대안은 다른 지점, 기간 연장, 환불처럼 서로 다른 것으로 골라요.

questions.question: That's the end of the situation. Have you ever had a problem with a service you paid for, such as a gym, a class, or a delivery? Tell me what happened and how the problem was solved.

il.text: Yes. Last year I ordered a jacket online. But it was the wrong size. I called the store. They sent a new jacket. It was okay. I was happy. The new one was perfect.
I took a cooking class last month. But the teacher was sick. The class was canceled two times. I asked for my money. They gave me a refund. It was fine.

im1.text: Yes, I had a problem with a swimming class last year. I paid for two months, but after two weeks, the pool closed because of a problem with the water. I was disappointed because I really liked the class. I called the sports center, and they said they would add two weeks to my class. In the end, I could finish the class, so it was okay.

I had a problem with a food delivery last month. I ordered fried chicken for my family, but it took almost two hours to arrive. When it came, it was cold. I called the restaurant and told them about the problem. The owner said sorry and gave me a coupon for my next order. I was still a little upset, but I liked that he said sorry.
phrases: I was still a little upset

im2.text: Yes, I had a similar problem with an English academy about two years ago. I signed up for a three-month speaking course and paid for it in advance. But after one month, my teacher suddenly quit, and the academy didn't have a new teacher for three weeks. I was really frustrated because I was preparing for a job interview. I called the manager and explained the situation. At first, she just said sorry. But I asked for a refund for the missed classes, and she finally agreed. She also gave me a free online class. In the end, I was satisfied with the result.
phrases: I was satisfied with the result

im2.text: I had a problem with a moving company when I moved to a new apartment last year. I booked the company two weeks before, and I paid a deposit. But on moving day, the workers came three hours late, and they broke one of my chairs. I was really upset because I had to wait all morning. I called the company and told them what happened. They apologized and paid for a new chair. They also gave me a small discount. It was a stressful day, but they solved the problem well.

im3.text: Actually, something like that happened to me last year with a yoga studio near my office. I bought a six-month membership because it was on sale, and I went three times a week. But after about two months, the studio suddenly closed without any notice. When I went there one evening, the door was locked, and there was just a small sign on the door. I was really shocked, and I was worried that I'd lose all my money. I called the owner many times, but she didn't answer. Finally, I contacted the consumer protection center, and they helped me get most of my money back. It took almost two months, but I learned to be careful about paying for a long time in advance.

Yes, I remember a problem with an online shopping order last winter. I ordered a new laptop for school, and the website said it would arrive in three days. But a week later, it still hadn't arrived. I checked the tracking information, and it said the laptop was delivered, but I never got it. I was so worried because it was really expensive. I called the customer service center, and at first they said I should check with my neighbors. But I explained that I had already checked everywhere. In the end, they found out the driver had delivered it to the wrong building, and they sent me a new one. It was stressful, but it worked out.
phrases: In the end, they found out

ih.text: Yes, I've had a few problems like that, but the one I remember most clearly happened with a gym, actually. About three years ago, I signed up for a one-year membership at a gym near my old apartment, because it was much cheaper than paying every month. For the first few months, everything was great. But then the gym changed owners, and the new owner started cutting back on everything. They reduced the opening hours, canceled most of the group classes, and stopped cleaning the showers properly. I complained to the staff several times, but nothing changed. Eventually, I wrote a detailed email to the new owner explaining that the service wasn't what I'd paid for. To my surprise, he called me the next day, apologized, and offered me a refund for the remaining months. I took the refund and joined a different gym, and I've been much happier since then.

I had a pretty frustrating experience with a furniture delivery about a year ago. I'd just moved into a new apartment, and I ordered a sofa and a dining table from an online store. They promised to deliver everything within a week, so I took a day off work to wait for them. But on the delivery day, nobody showed up, and nobody called me either. When I finally reached customer service, they told me the items were still at the warehouse because of a scheduling mistake. I was really annoyed, since I'd wasted a whole day off. I explained that I couldn't take another day off, and I asked them to deliver on a weekend instead. After some back and forth, they agreed, and they also gave me a discount for the trouble. It wasn't a great experience, but at least they tried to make it right.
phrases: at least they tried to make it right

al.text: Oh, absolutely. The one that comes to mind happened about two years ago, when I signed up for an intensive coding bootcamp. It was a twelve-week course, and it wasn't cheap, but I was hoping it would help me switch careers. For the first few weeks, everything went smoothly, but then our main instructor suddenly left, and the replacement clearly didn't know the material very well. The quality of the lessons dropped dramatically, and a lot of us felt like we were wasting our time and money. At first, I just complained to my classmates, but eventually I realized that wasn't going to change anything. So I organized a short meeting with a few other students, and we wrote a polite but firm letter to the director, listing specific problems and suggesting solutions. To their credit, the school responded within a week. They brought in an experienced instructor for the rest of the course and offered everyone a partial refund. Looking back, it taught me that complaining is much more effective when you're organized and propose realistic solutions.
phrases: The one that comes to mind

al.text: Yes, I actually had a frustrating experience with a cooking class last spring. I'd paid for an eight-week course on Korean home cooking, mostly because I wanted to learn how to make the dishes my grandmother used to cook. However, after the third week, the classes started getting canceled at the last minute, usually with a text message about an hour before we were supposed to start. At first, I tried to be understanding, since the teacher said she had family issues. But after the fourth cancellation, I'd already wasted several evenings rearranging my schedule, so I decided to call the cooking studio directly. I explained the situation calmly and pointed out that I'd paid for eight classes but had only attended three. The manager was apologetic and offered two options: either join a different teacher's class on weekends or get a refund for the remaining sessions. I chose the weekend class, and it turned out to be even better than the original one. In the end, things worked out, but it reminded me to speak up early rather than just waiting.

questions.tip_ko: 꼭 헬스장 이야기가 아니어도 돼요. 돈을 냈는데 서비스가 약속과 달랐던 일 하나를 골라 문제, 대처, 결과 순서로 말해요.

hotel.situation_ko: 여행 갈 호텔에 전화해서 방과 서비스를 물어보고, 도착했을 때 방이 중복 예약된 문제를 해결해요.

questions.question: I'd like to give you a situation and ask you to act it out. You are planning a weekend trip and want to stay at a hotel. Call the hotel and ask three or four questions about the rooms and services.

il.text: Hi. I want to book a room this weekend. How much is a room? Is breakfast free? Do you have parking? Thank you.
phrases: I want to book a room

il.text: Hello. I have some questions. Do you have a room for two people on Saturday? What time is check-in? Is there a pool? Thanks.
phrases: Do you have a room for

im1.text: Hi, I'm calling about a room. I want to stay at your hotel this weekend with my wife. Do you have a double room for Friday and Saturday? How much is it per night? Is breakfast included? And is there free Wi-Fi in the room? Thank you.
phrases: How much is it per night

im1.text: Hello, I have a few questions. I'm planning a trip with my friend next month. Do you have a room with two beds? What time is check-in and check-out? Is there a restaurant in the hotel? Also, how far is the hotel from the beach? Thank you.
phrases: how far is the hotel from

im2.text: Hi, I'm calling because I want to book a room for a weekend trip. My family is coming with me, so we need a room for four people. First, do you have a family room available next Saturday? Second, how much does it cost for one night? Also, is breakfast included in the price? And is there a parking lot for guests? Thank you very much.
phrases: is breakfast included in the price

im2.text: Hello, I'm planning to visit your city for a business trip next week, and I'm looking for a hotel. Can I ask you some questions? Do you have a single room from Monday to Wednesday? Is there a desk in the room? I need to work at night. Also, is there a shuttle bus to the train station? Finally, can I check in late, around eleven at night? Thanks.
phrases: Can I ask you some questions

im3.text: Hi there, I'm planning a short trip to the coast with my best friend, and I found your hotel online, so I have a few questions. First of all, do you have any rooms with an ocean view for next Friday and Saturday? If so, how much would that be per night? Also, does the price include breakfast? Is there a pool? Lastly, is it possible to check out a little late on Sunday? Thank you.
phrases: is it possible to check out a little late

im3.text: Hello, I'm calling because my parents are visiting me next month, and I'd like to book a comfortable hotel for them. They're in their sixties, so I have some questions. Is there an elevator in the building? Do you have rooms with two beds on a lower floor? How much is it for three nights? And is there a restaurant nearby where they can have dinner easily? Thanks for your help.

ih.text: Hi, how are you doing? I'm organizing a weekend getaway for my wife's birthday next month, and your hotel looks perfect, so I just wanted to ask a few questions before I make a reservation. To begin with, do you have any rooms with a balcony available on the fourteenth and fifteenth? Next, what's the total price for two nights, including tax? I'm also wondering if you offer any special packages for birthdays, like flowers or a cake in the room. Finally, would you recommend a good restaurant nearby? Thanks a lot.

Hello, I hope you can help me. I'm attending a conference near your hotel at the end of this month, and a few of my coworkers will be coming too. So first, I'd like to know if you have four single rooms from the twenty-fifth to the twenty-eighth. Second, do you offer a corporate discount for group bookings? We'd also need a quiet place to work, so is there a business center we could use? And lastly, how long does it take to get from the hotel to the convention center? Thank you.
phrases: do you offer a corporate discount
how long does it take to get

al.text: Hi, thanks for taking my call. I'm planning a trip with a group of friends from college next month, and we're trying to decide between a couple of hotels, so I'd love to ask you a few things. First of all, we're looking at three rooms from the ninth to the twelfth. Do you have availability for those dates, and could the rooms be on the same floor? Second, what's your cancellation policy? A couple of my friends aren't sure about their schedules yet. Also, is your rooftop bar open to guests every night? And finally, is there an easy way to get downtown without renting a car? Thanks so much for your time.
phrases: Thanks so much for your time

al.text: Hello, I hope I'm not calling at a bad time. My husband and I are planning a quiet getaway for our tenth anniversary, and a friend highly recommended your hotel, so I wanted to check a few details. To start with, do you have any rooms with a mountain view for the last weekend of next month? We'd prefer somewhere away from the elevator, since we're both light sleepers. Next, is breakfast served in the room or only in the restaurant? I'm also curious whether we need to book spa treatments in advance. And lastly, is there free parking on site? Thank you so much.

questions.tip_ko: 날짜와 인원을 먼저 말하고 질문으로 넘어가요. 가격, 조식, 위치처럼 서로 다른 주제로 질문을 고르면 덜 겹쳐요.

questions.question: I'm sorry, but there's a problem. When you arrive at the hotel, the clerk tells you that your room was double-booked and there is no room for you tonight. Explain the situation and suggest two or three ways to solve it.

il.text: Excuse me. There is a problem. You don't have a room for me. But I booked a room. Can you find another room? Or another hotel? Thank you. Please help me.
Hi. I booked a room for tonight. But you say there is no room. I am very tired. Can I get a room in another hotel? Or can I get my money back?
phrases: Or can I get my money back

im1.text: Excuse me, I have a problem. I booked a room online two weeks ago, and I paid for it. But you say my room was double-booked, and there are no rooms tonight. I'm really tired after a long trip. Could you find me a room at another hotel nearby? Or maybe you have a different type of room? If not, I need a full refund. Thank you.
phrases: Could you find me a room
If not, I need a full refund

im1.text: Hi, I'm sorry, but this is a big problem for me. I reserved a double room for two nights, and here is my confirmation email. Now you're telling me there's no room for me tonight. It's very late, and I don't know this city. Can you call another hotel for me? Or can I stay in a bigger room and pay the same price? Please help me. Thank you.
phrases: this is a big problem for me

im2.text: Excuse me, I'm sorry, but I think there's a serious problem. I booked a double room at this hotel a month ago for tonight and tomorrow, and I already paid for it. Here's my confirmation number. But you just told me that the room was double-booked and that there are no rooms available. My wife and I just finished a five-hour drive, so we're really tired. Could you please help us in one of these ways? First, maybe you could upgrade us to a suite if one is free. Second, you could find us a room at a hotel nearby and pay for the taxi. Or third, please give us a full refund. Thank you.

Hi, I'm afraid there's been a mistake. I made a reservation for a single room for three nights, and I got an email from your hotel last week. But now you're saying someone else is already in my room and there are no other rooms. I have an important meeting early tomorrow morning, so I really need a place to sleep tonight. Could you check again for any room, even a small one? If there's really nothing, could you book me a room at a hotel close to here? And of course, I'd like a refund for tonight. Thanks for your help.
phrases: I'm afraid there's been a mistake

im3.text: Excuse me, I'm really sorry to bother you, but I think there's a problem with my reservation. I booked a room with two beds for my kids and me about three weeks ago, and I even got a confirmation email. But now you're telling me that the room has been double-booked and there's nothing left for tonight. It's almost eleven, and my kids are falling asleep in the lobby, so I really need your help. I have a few ideas. First, could you check if there's any other type of room available, even a more expensive one? If there's really nothing, could you find us a room at another hotel nearby and arrange a taxi? And if neither is possible, I'd need a full refund. Thank you.

Hi, sorry, but I have a pretty big problem here. I booked a room at this hotel for my business trip, and the reservation was made by my company. I have the confirmation right here on my phone. But the clerk just told me that the room was given to someone else by mistake. I flew in from Seoul today, and I have a presentation tomorrow at nine, so I really can't spend the night looking for a hotel. Would it be possible to put me in a different room, maybe a suite, for the same price? If not, could you contact one of your partner hotels and book a room for me? Of course, I'd also like you to cover the cost of getting there. Thanks a lot.
phrases: I have a pretty big problem here

ih.text: Excuse me, I'm really sorry to bother you when you're this busy, but I think there's been a serious mix-up with my booking. I reserved an ocean-view room here about two months ago for my parents' anniversary trip, and I paid the full amount in advance. Here's the confirmation email, if you'd like to see it. But the clerk just told me that the room has been double-booked and that the hotel is completely full tonight. As you can imagine, this is really disappointing, because my parents have been looking forward to this for weeks. So I'd like to suggest a few options. Ideally, you could upgrade us to another room, even if it doesn't have an ocean view. If that's impossible, could you book us a similar room at a nearby hotel and pay for the transportation? And finally, I think a refund for tonight would be fair either way. Thank you for understanding.

Hi, I'm sorry, but I've just run into a pretty frustrating problem, and I really need your help. I booked a single room here for three nights through your website, and I got a confirmation email right away. But when I tried to check in a few minutes ago, the clerk told me that my room had been given to another guest because of a system error, and that there's nothing left tonight. To be honest, I'm exhausted. My flight was delayed for four hours, and I have a job interview tomorrow morning. So here's what I'd like to ask. First, could you double-check whether any room has been canceled tonight? Second, if not, could you find me a room at a hotel within walking distance and cover the difference in price? And third, I'd appreciate a refund for tonight, or at least a discount for the next two nights. Thank you.
phrases: So here's what I'd like to ask

al.text: Excuse me, I'm sorry to interrupt, but I'm afraid we have a bit of a situation here, and I'm hoping you can help me sort it out. About two months ago, I booked a deluxe room at this hotel for three nights. It's my wife's fortieth birthday this weekend, and I've been planning this trip as a surprise for quite a while. I've got the confirmation email right here, and I paid the full amount when I booked. However, the gentleman at the front desk just told me that the room was double-booked and that the hotel is completely full tonight. Honestly, I'm pretty upset, because my wife is waiting in the car and I really don't want to ruin her birthday. So let me suggest a few possible solutions. First, if any suite or higher-category room is still available, could you upgrade us at no extra charge? If not, could you arrange a similar room at a nearby hotel and cover the taxi fare? And regardless of which option works out, I'd really appreciate some kind of refund for the trouble. Thank you.
phrases: let me suggest a few possible solutions
regardless of which option works out

al.text: Hi there, I'm really sorry to bother you this late, but I've just been told something rather alarming, and I'd like to see what we can do about it. I reserved a twin room here for my mother and me about a month ago, and I received a confirmation email the very same day. Unfortunately, when we arrived, the night manager told us that the room had been double-booked and that there's simply nothing available. My mother is in her seventies and she's exhausted after a long flight, so spending the next hour driving around looking for a place really isn't an option for us. With that in mind, I'd like to propose a few alternatives. First of all, perhaps there's a room being held for late arrivals that could be released to us. If that's not possible, would you be willing to book us into a comparable hotel nearby and arrange a taxi? Finally, I think it would only be fair to refund the full cost of tonight's stay. I'd really appreciate your help.
phrases: it would only be fair to

questions.tip_ko: 예약 확인 메일이나 번호가 있다고 먼저 말하면 설명이 짧아져요. 대안은 다른 방, 다른 호텔, 환불 순서로 말해요.

questions.question: That's the end of the situation. Have you ever had a problem while staying at a hotel or another place during a trip? Tell me what happened and how it was resolved.

il.text: Yes, I had a problem in a hotel. The air conditioner didn't work. It was very hot. I called the front desk. They gave me a new room. I was happy.
phrases: I had a problem in a hotel

il.text: Last year, I stayed at a hotel in Busan. My room was very dirty. I told the staff. They cleaned the room again. After that, it was okay. I slept well.

im1.text: Yes, I had a problem during a trip to Gangneung last summer. When I checked into my hotel room, the shower didn't have hot water. I was so tired, and I really wanted to take a hot shower. I called the front desk, and they sent someone to fix it. But he couldn't fix it, so they moved me to another room. The new room was bigger, so I was happy in the end.
phrases: they moved me to another room

im1.text: I remember a problem I had in Japan two years ago. I stayed at a small hotel with my sister. In the middle of the night, the people in the next room were very loud. We couldn't sleep at all. In the morning, I told the staff about it. They said sorry and gave us a free breakfast. It wasn't perfect, but I liked that they tried to help.
phrases: In the middle of the night

im2.text: Yes, I had a problem like that during a family trip to Jeju Island about three years ago. We booked two rooms next to each other because my parents wanted to stay close to us. But when we arrived, the hotel gave us rooms on different floors. My mom was really disappointed. I went back to the front desk and explained the situation politely. At first, the staff said there were no other rooms. But after a while, the manager found two rooms next to each other on the top floor. They even had a great view of the sea. In the end, it turned out even better than we expected.
phrases: it turned out even better than we expected

im2.text: I had a bad experience at a guesthouse in Gyeongju last spring. I booked a private room online, but when I arrived, they said my room was given to someone else. I was really upset because it was late at night. The owner apologized and called a few places nearby, and finally she found a room at another guesthouse. She also drove me there and refunded my money. I was tired and annoyed that night, but I appreciated her kindness. Now, I always call the place one day before I arrive to check my reservation.

im3.text: Actually, something similar happened to me last winter when I went on a business trip to Daegu. I booked a hotel near the office through a travel website, and I paid for three nights in advance. But when I arrived after a long train ride, the front desk couldn't find my reservation at all. It turned out that the website had a technical problem, and my booking never reached the hotel. I was so frustrated because I had an important meeting the next morning. Fortunately, the clerk was very helpful. She gave me the last room they had, which was a suite, for the price of a normal room. After the trip, I contacted the website, and they refunded my money. It ended up being a pretty lucky mistake.

Yes, I remember one time when I stayed at a hotel in Hong Kong with my friends. On our second night, we came back to our room and found that the door lock didn't work. We couldn't get into the room, and all of our bags were inside. It was almost midnight, so we were really tired and a little scared. We went down to the front desk, and they sent a staff member to help us. It took almost an hour to open the door. The hotel apologized and gave us free breakfast for the rest of the trip. It was annoying at the time, but now it's a funny memory.
phrases: It was annoying at the time

ih.text: Yes, I've actually had a pretty memorable problem at a hotel. It happened about two years ago, when I went to Osaka with three of my friends from university. We had booked two twin rooms months in advance, and we were all really excited. But when we arrived late at night, the clerk told us that only one room was available because of an overbooking issue. At first, we didn't know what to do, since we were in a foreign country and couldn't speak much Japanese. Luckily, one of my friends stayed calm and explained the situation in English. The manager apologized many times and offered us a large family room with four beds for the same price. On top of that, he gave us vouchers for breakfast. It turned out to be one of the best parts of the trip, because we all stayed up talking every night.

I had a really frustrating experience during a road trip with my family last summer. We stopped at a small hotel in the countryside, and I had booked a room with three beds online. When we got there, the room they gave us only had one bed, and the air conditioner wasn't working, even though it was over thirty degrees outside. I went to the front desk and explained the problem, but the young man working there said he couldn't do anything because the manager had gone home. I didn't want to argue, so I asked him to call the manager. About twenty minutes later, the manager arrived, apologized, and moved us to a much bigger room on the top floor. He also gave us a discount for the night. Since then, I've learned that staying polite but firm is the best way to solve these kinds of problems.

al.text: Oh, I've definitely had my share of hotel problems, but the one that sticks out happened in Vietnam a couple of years ago. My wife and I had booked a beach resort for our honeymoon, and we'd specifically requested an ocean-view villa. When we arrived after a long flight, though, they put us in a standard room facing the parking lot. On top of that, the bathroom had a leak, so the floor was constantly wet. I was really disappointed, because we'd paid quite a lot for that trip. Instead of getting angry, I went to the front desk the next morning, showed them our original booking, and calmly explained that this wasn't what we'd paid for. The manager checked the system and admitted they'd made a mistake. Not only did they move us to the villa we'd originally booked, but they also gave us a free dinner for two at their lovely seaside restaurant. Looking back, I think staying calm and having the paperwork ready made all the difference.
phrases: I've definitely had my share of

al.text: Yes, I remember one experience very clearly, because it happened on the first night of a business trip to Singapore last year. I'd booked a room close to the client's office, and since I had an early meeting, I wanted to get a good night's sleep. Unfortunately, the moment I lay down, I realized the room was right next to a busy construction site that was apparently working through the night. It was so loud that I couldn't sleep at all. I called the front desk around midnight, and while the clerk was polite, she said the hotel was fully booked. Rather than give up, I asked whether she could at least move me to a room on the opposite side as soon as one became available. The next morning, they moved me to a quiet room on a higher floor and took one night off my bill. It wasn't a perfect stay, but I was impressed by how they handled it, and I've actually stayed there again since then.
phrases: I was impressed by how they handled it

questions.tip_ko: 롤플레이 상황과 비슷한 경험을 하나 골라요. 문제, 내가 한 일, 결과를 시간 순서로 말하고 지금 생각을 덧붙여요.

movie_tickets.situation_ko: 주말에 볼 영화표를 예매하려고 영화관에 전화하고, 예매 날짜가 잘못된 문제를 해결해요.

questions.question: I'd like to give you a situation and ask you to act it out. You want to see a movie this weekend. Call the movie theater and ask three or four questions to get the information you need to buy tickets.

il.text: Hi. I want to see a movie tonight. What movies are playing? What time is the last show? How much is a ticket? Thank you.
Hello. I have some questions. What time does the action movie start? Is there a student discount? Can I buy popcorn there? Thanks.

im1.text: Hi, I'm calling about movie tickets. I want to watch a movie this Saturday with my friend. What movies are showing this weekend? What time do they start? How much are the tickets? And can I book online? Thank you so much.

Hello, I'd like to ask some questions. I'm planning to see a movie on Friday night. Is the new comedy still playing? What is the last show time? Do you have any discounts for students? Thank you for your help.
phrases: I'd like to ask some questions

im2.text: Hi, I'm calling because I want to buy movie tickets for this Saturday. I'm going with two friends, so I need three tickets. First, what movies are playing in the evening? Second, what time does the last show start? Also, how much is each ticket? Finally, can we choose our seats now? Thanks a lot.

Hello, I have a few questions about your theater. My family wants to see a movie on Sunday afternoon. Are there any family movies playing this weekend? What times are the shows? Is there a discount for children? And is there a parking lot near the theater? I really appreciate your help.
phrases: I have a few questions about

im3.text: Hi there, I'm thinking about seeing a movie with my coworkers this Friday after work, so I have a few questions. First of all, which movies are playing around seven in the evening? Also, how long is the new science fiction movie? I heard it's almost three hours. Do you offer any group discounts? Lastly, can I reserve seats in the middle of the theater? Thank you so much.

Hello, I'm calling because I'd like to take my parents to a movie this weekend. They don't like loud action movies, so I'm wondering if there are any dramas or comedies playing on Saturday. What time do the afternoon shows start? Is there a discount for seniors? And one more thing, can I pick up the tickets at the counter when we arrive? Thanks a lot.
phrases: Is there a discount for seniors

ih.text: Hi, how are you? I'm planning a little movie night for my friend's birthday this Saturday, so I wanted to check a few things before I book. First, which movies are playing around seven? We're mostly into comedies, but we're open to anything. Second, how much does a ticket cost on weekends, and is there a discount if we buy five or more? Also, do you have reclining seats? And finally, can we bring a small birthday cake inside? Thanks for your help.
phrases: I wanted to check a few things

ih.text: Hello, I hope you're not too busy. I'd like to see the new animated movie with my niece and nephew next Sunday, and I have some questions. To begin with, what time are the morning shows? The kids get tired easily, so earlier would be better. Next, how much are children's tickets? I'm also wondering whether the movie is dubbed or has subtitles, because the kids can't read very fast. Lastly, if we arrive a little late, can we still get in? Thank you so much.
phrases: I hope you're not too busy

al.text: Hi, thanks for picking up. I'm putting together a small outing for my team this Friday, and we'd love to see a movie together after work, so I just want to go over a few details. First of all, what's showing between seven and eight in the evening? We were hoping for something light, maybe a comedy. Second, do you offer group rates? There'll be about eight of us. Also, could we reserve seats together in one row, preferably toward the back? And lastly, do you sell actual meals inside, or should we eat before the show? I really appreciate it.
phrases: I just want to go over a few details

al.text: Hello, I hope I'm calling the right number. My wife and I are celebrating our anniversary next Saturday, and we were thinking of catching a late movie after dinner, so I have a handful of questions. To start with, what's the latest show that night, and roughly when does it end? Next, I heard you recently added premium seats with extra space. How much more do those cost? On top of that, is there any package with drinks or snacks included? And finally, if dinner runs long, can we change our tickets without paying a fee? Thanks so much.
phrases: I have a handful of questions

questions.tip_ko: 처음에 왜 전화했는지 한 문장으로 밝히고, 질문 3~4개를 First, Also, Lastly로 이어 가요.

questions.question: I'm sorry, but there's a problem. When you arrive at the theater, you find out that the tickets you booked are for the wrong date. Explain the problem to the person at the ticket counter and offer two or three ways to solve it.

il.text: Excuse me. I have a problem. I booked two tickets for today, but the tickets are for tomorrow. I'm sorry. Can I change them to today? Or can I get a refund? Thank you.
phrases: Or can I get a refund

il.text: Hi. There is a problem with my tickets. The date is wrong. I want to see the movie today. Can you change my tickets? If not, can I watch a later show? Thanks.

im1.text: Excuse me, I'm sorry to bother you, but I have a problem. I booked two tickets online for the seven o'clock show, but I just checked, and the tickets are for tomorrow, not today. It was my mistake. Can I change them to tonight's show? If the seven o'clock show is full, the nine o'clock show is fine too. Or maybe I can get a refund. Thank you very much.

Hi, I have a problem with my movie tickets. My friend and I came here to see the new comedy tonight, but the tickets say Saturday, and today is Friday. I think I chose the wrong date on the website. Is it possible to change the date? If there are no seats tonight, we can come back tomorrow. Or could you give us a refund? Thanks for your help.
phrases: Or could you give us a refund

im2.text: Excuse me, I'm sorry, but I think there's a problem with my booking. I reserved two tickets for the eight o'clock show online yesterday, but the staff at the entrance said they're for next Friday. I must have clicked the wrong date. My friend came all the way here to see this movie with me, so I really want to watch it tonight. Could you change our tickets to tonight's show? If that show is sold out, we could watch the ten o'clock show instead. Or, if that's not possible, could you give me a full refund? Thank you for understanding.
phrases: I must have clicked the wrong date
If that show is sold out

im2.text: Hi, I hope you can help me. I booked three tickets for my family for the afternoon show, but I just noticed the tickets are for the wrong date. They're for next week. My kids are really excited, so we don't want to go home without seeing the movie. Here are some options. First, could you move our tickets to today's three o'clock show? Second, if there are no three seats together, we can sit separately. Third, if both options don't work, I'd like a refund, and we'll just buy tickets for another movie today. Thanks a lot.
phrases: I hope you can help me

im3.text: Excuse me, I'm really sorry to bother you, but I just realized I made a mistake with my booking. I reserved two seats for tonight's seven-thirty show, or at least I thought I did. But when I checked the tickets on my phone, they're actually for next Tuesday. My friend and I both took the evening off to see this movie, so we were really disappointed. I was wondering if you could help us in one of a few ways. First, could you change the date to tonight? We don't mind sitting in the front row. If the show is completely sold out, maybe we could watch the late show at ten instead. And if none of that works, could you refund the tickets? Thank you so much.
phrases: or at least I thought I did
I was wondering if you could

im3.text: Hi, I'm sorry, but I have a bit of a problem. Last night I booked four tickets for the new action movie for me and my cousins, and I paid with my credit card. But today, when we got here, I noticed the tickets are for Sunday, not Saturday. It was totally my fault because I was booking in a hurry. Anyway, we're here now, and we'd really love to see the movie. Would it be possible to switch the tickets to today's two o'clock show? If that show is full, the four-thirty show would also work for us. Otherwise, could you cancel the tickets and give me a refund? Then we'll just watch something else. Thanks for your help.
phrases: Would it be possible to switch

ih.text: Excuse me, I'm so sorry to bother you when you're busy, but I've got a small problem with my tickets. A few days ago I booked two seats for tonight's eight o'clock show of the new mystery movie. At least, that's what I thought. But when I opened the tickets on my phone just now, I saw that I'd actually booked them for next Saturday. I guess I picked the wrong date on the calendar. The thing is, my girlfriend has been waiting for this movie for weeks. So I was hoping you could help me out. Could you possibly swap the tickets for tonight's show? If there aren't two seats together, we're fine sitting apart. If the eight o'clock show is completely full, the ten-fifteen show would also be okay. And if neither works, I'd just like a refund, and we'll try again next week. Thank you so much for your help.
phrases: I was hoping you could help me out

ih.text: Hi, sorry, do you have a minute? I think I messed up my booking, and I'm hoping you can help me fix it. I bought three tickets online for the animated movie this afternoon, because I promised my nephews we'd see it during their school break. When we got here, the staff at the entrance told me the tickets were for tomorrow. I double-checked, and they were right. I must have tapped the wrong day. Now the boys look really disappointed, so I'd love to find a way to make this work. Would you be able to change the tickets to the one-thirty show today? If that one's sold out, the three-forty show would be fine as well. Or, if all the shows today are full, could you just refund the tickets? Then we'll grab some lunch and come back tomorrow. I really appreciate it.

I'd love to find a way to make this work

al.text: Excuse me, I'm really sorry to interrupt, but I'm in a bit of a bind and I was hoping you could help. Earlier this week, I booked two tickets for tonight's seven-thirty showing of the new historical drama. I was planning to surprise my mother, since she's been talking about this movie for ages. But when I pulled up the tickets on my phone just now, I noticed they're actually for the same time next Thursday. I must have scrolled one week too far when I was choosing the date. Anyway, my mom's already on her way in, so I'd really love to sort this out quickly. Here's what I was thinking. Ideally, you could just move the booking to tonight, even if the seats aren't as good. If tonight's show is fully booked, we'd be happy to wait for the nine forty-five showing instead. And if neither of those is possible, I'd appreciate a refund, or maybe a credit I could use next time. I completely understand it was my mistake, so whatever you can do would be great.

whatever you can do would be great

al.text: Hi there, sorry to bother you. I've run into a problem with my booking, and I'm hoping there's something you can do. So, a couple of days ago, I reserved four tickets for this evening's six o'clock show for me and some friends from work. We all rushed here straight from the office, but when we tried to get in, the staff told us the tickets were for last Friday, not today. Apparently, I booked them a week ago and never noticed the date. To be honest, that's pretty embarrassing, since I organized the whole thing. I know the tickets probably can't be used anymore, but I wanted to ask about a few options. First, is there any way you could exchange them for tonight's show, maybe for a small fee? If not, could you at least give us a discount on four new tickets? And if neither is possible, we'll just buy new ones for the eight-fifteen show, as long as there are four seats together. Thanks for hearing me out.
